svg.title: Agentic RAG: choose sources, check evidence, and retry
svg.desc: A horizontal adaptation of the original numbered Agentic RAG diagram. Follow the top row from the user through the LLM app and agent orchestrator to retrieval sources. Continue down the right side, then left through retrieved evidence, evaluator, context builder and LLM. Insufficient evidence returns to the orchestrator, with a five-try maximum. The answer goes back to the app, then the response to the user.
svg.text: Choose sources → check evidence → retry if needed → build context and answer.
